description: Turn Nymwell's auto-renew on or off for a domain. When it is on and the workspace has a saved card, Nymwell charges that card for a one-year renewal from 14 days before expiry (retrying 7, 3 and 1 day before); without a card it sends reminders instead. The answer says which applies. The registrar's own auto-renew always stays off.
name: set_auto_renew
